title: Grateful Dead Live at Oakland Auditorium Arena on 1982-12-31
source: FM Radio Broadcast > Cassete > Wave > Flac

ai_review.summary: High‑energy New Year's Eve show with a standout third set and a well‑balanced matrix mix that lets the band sparkle.
ai_review.review: The concert is praised for its nonstop energy, especially the horn‑filled third set featuring Lovelight and a midnight ring‑in with Sugar Mag. Reviewers note that this FM/matrix mix balances the Tower of Power horns far better than other versions, giving a gritty yet pleasing sound despite lacking the crispness of a pure SBD tape.

ai_rating.rationale: Consistently high star ratings (mostly 5) and enthusiastic comments about both performance and mix indicate a strong show with good‑to‑excellent recording quality.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Mix is praised for balancing the horns, offering a gritty/funkier vibe than the SBD capture. Not as crisp as a pure soundboard but generally pleasing and clear enough to hear all band members.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Solid song selection throughout; third set highlighted by Etta James and Tower of Power horn guests, creating a memorable climax.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Described as "on fire" with sparkling playing during the third set.
